description: Everything get_project returns, plus what the platform observes: each container's state, health, restart count and image digest, the node and tier, the ingress hostnames, the disk quota, the secret set version the running containers were deployed with, and the last failure with its class. Use this when a deploy has failed or a service is not answering and get_deploy_status has told you only that. The platform half is best-effort: a project that has never deployed has no record there, and the answer degrades to get_project rather than failing.
name: get_project_detail
title: Diagnose the project
